correctness.rationale: Beta integration gives exact monomial weights; the gamma-ratio coefficient expansion is valid for every fixed alpha>-1; gcd divisibility yields a noncompact witness for g>1 and an orthogonal sparse transfer for g=1. The 1/j coefficient is nonzero except at alpha=0 (when the operator vanishes identically); singular-value rearrangement proves the sharp limit, and an l1 difference from the harmonic sequence proves the logarithmic trace. 900 direct finite identities, six asymptotic diagnostics, three noncoprime witnesses were additionally executed.

value.rationale: A full arithmetic gcd dichotomy for a mixed adjoint commutator of two natural composition semigroup generators, coupled to a sharp endpoint singular-value residue and Schatten classification, provides a structural operator-ideal invariant. The classical Dirichlet exact cancellation and weighted weak-trace obstruction motivate the precise constants; the result is neither a one-symbol textbook calculation nor a numerical parameter slice.
